title: 云南锗业涨停与百胜绩后走强获确认，恒科逆势回落压制科技普涨
summary: 截至09:59，上证跌0.21%、创业板涨0.32%，恒指跌0.31%、恒科跌1.21%。云南锗业涨停确认磷化铟长单，百胜中国涨2.80%确认业绩；威胜信息跌0.81%降为回避，游族上涨但高风险不变。

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
中东停火谈判仍远、油价延续回落
Reuters称美伊仍未接近结束冲突的协议，美国夜间袭击伊朗格什姆岛防空目标；Brent结算跌1.12%至103.60美元。油价回落利于航空、物流与下游制造成本，但地缘升级仍可快速逆转。来源：Reuters。
政策
千亿元互换便利继续托底资本市场
人民银行11月3日开展1000亿元证券、基金、保险公司互换便利操作；回购增持再贷款转为长期安排、利率降至1%。政策提升机构和产业资本的流动性，但不保证高估值题材同步上涨。来源：人民银行公告转录。
政策
外汇存款准备金率上调至6%
人民银行决定11月15日起将外汇存款准备金率由4%上调至6%，管理外汇流动性并抑制人民币单边升值预期；Reuters估算约抽回240亿美元外汇流动性。出口链汇兑压力可能缓和，但人民币资产外资情绪需观察。来源：人民银行消息、Reuters。
政策
发改委部署新兴支柱产业与“人工智能+”
国家发展改革委11月3日发布会覆盖新兴支柱产业、未来产业、“人工智能+”、数据要素和数字中国。对算力、数据基础设施和产业数字化形成中期支撑，短线仍需订单与价格确认。来源：国家发展改革委。
美股
AMD业绩超预期、半导体链反弹
AMD三季度营收134亿美元、调整后EPS 2.09美元，数据中心收入同比增97%；第四季度收入指引约170亿美元，高于市场预期。运行时公开延长时段报价AMD 483.90美元、较前收+3.73%，A/H映射聚焦服务器、先进封装、PCB和光通信。来源：AMD及运行时公开报价。
排行
电气设备与加密主题领涨、食品分销领跌
11月3日美股现金时段，电气设备及零件+5.76%、电子元件+4.02%，加密矿企+13.77%、加密储备+5.83%；食品分销-6.34%。电力设备、储能与光器件有A/H映射，加密主题未核验出直接A/H候选，禁止用情绪关联硬凑推荐。来源：GitHub Actions/Moomoo快照，08:32 CST。
确认
云南锗业涨停确认磷化铟长单催化
09:59云南锗业75.38元、涨10.00%，盘中高点75.38元、低点72.00元，较前收68.53元获得强正向确认。长期协议仍取决于年度订单、出口许可证、产能与良率。来源：东方财富公开延迟行情、公司公告转录。
风险
游族反弹不改变超大额采购风险
09:59游族网络10.90元、涨1.68%，但42.25亿元GPU采购约为2025年营收三倍，交易对手、资金来源、下游客户与变现路径仍不充分；单日反弹不足以覆盖现金流、交付与减值风险。来源：东方财富公开延迟行情、巨潮资讯公告。
确认
威胜信息未获开盘价格确认
09:59威胜信息25.65元、跌0.81%，低于前收25.86元，2.31亿元中标或预中标催化未转化为正反馈，故降为回避。来源：东方财富公开延迟行情、上交所公告页。
回报
东山精密控股股东提议强化股东回报
控股股东提议未来三年股东回报安排，2026年度现金分红及回购合计不低于10亿元；该提议并非董事会决议，仍需董事会和股东会审议。11月3日收盘88.13元、跌4.41%。来源：巨潮资讯公告。
确认
百胜中国港股涨2.80%确认业绩
09:59百胜中国389.40港元、涨2.80%，较前收378.80港元获得正向确认；三季度营收、经营利润和摊薄EPS分别增长8%、13%和20%，但同店销售仍仅为上年同期97%。来源：东方财富公开延迟行情、港交所公告。
市场
A股分化企稳、恒科逆势走弱
09:59上证跌0.21%、创业板涨0.32%，恒指跌0.31%、恒生科技跌1.21%。A股较前日急跌后分化企稳，但港股科技未跟随隔夜美股修复，映射收窄到有公司催化且获价格确认的标的。来源：东方财富公开延迟行情。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
延长时段ETF代理维持科技强、道指弱
运行时公开报价截至08:17-08:18 CST：QQQ 685.28美元、较前收+0.63%；SPY 754.35美元、+0.30%；DIA 517.06美元、-0.44%。三者为延长时段ETF代理，涨跌为相对前收的累计变化，数据源未拆分收盘后单独增量。
板块对照
强势组大体获确认、弱势组代表股出现背离
行业Top5代表股STI +20.10%、ARRY +22.37%、YDKG +15.73%、SCNX +4.64%、FN +15.58%，均确认正向；Bottom5代表股PLBL +2.72%、SOC +0.61%、EPSM +8.31%、BXBL +3.88%、MTEX +2.52%均与所属行业负向相反，属于潜在反转/个股背离。概念Top5中RIOT +18.50%、BTBT +15.39%、CLSK +14.06%、ARTL +7.37%确认正向，MTWO报价不可得。报价时间为06:35-08:19 CST。
A/H 映射
隔夜强势只获选择性确认
云南锗业涨停确认光器件上游事件，百胜中国涨2.80%确认消费业绩；威胜信息跌0.81%未确认电网催化，恒生科技跌1.21%否定科技普涨。加密主题仍无已核验的直接A/H业务敞口，不生成情绪映射推荐。

盘中结论

09:59 A股分化企稳，云南锗业涨停与百胜中国涨2.80%分别确认磷化铟长单和消费业绩，结构性事件机会成立。

恒生科技跌1.21%，显著弱于恒指和隔夜美股科技，威胜信息亦跌0.81%；科技普涨与电网催化的广泛映射均未获确认。

策略收窄为价格确认后的双向分类：云南锗业、百胜中国列多头候选；威胜信息、游族网络列回避。加密主题仍无直接A/H候选。

重点个股关注

云南锗业
002428.SZ
多头候选

事实与状态：09:59报75.38元、涨10.00%并触及涨停，确认磷化铟长期协议催化；2027年度合同约13.05亿元。

确认条件：后续开板后仍守住公告后主要成交区，年度订单与出口许可无不利变化。

风险与失效：交付依赖订单、许可、产能和良率；放量跌回前收68.53元下方或许可受阻即失效。

威胜信息
688100.SH
回避

事实与状态：09:59报25.65元、跌0.81%，低于前收25.86元，2.31亿元中标或预中标未获正向价格确认。

确认条件：正式合同推进且重新站上25.86元，并相对电网设备板块转强后再评估。

风险与失效：部分项目尚未签约，收入确认与毛利率取决于交付；当前不具备多头卡条件。

百胜中国
09987.HK / YUMC
多头候选

事实与状态：09:59报389.40港元、涨2.80%，确认三季度营收、经营利润和EPS增长。

确认条件：维持在前收378.80港元上方，且餐饮消费板块不出现明显相对转弱。

风险与失效：同店销售仍仅为上年同期97%；跌回前收下方即降级。

游族网络
002174.SZ
回避

事实与状态：09:59报10.90元、涨1.68%，但42.25亿元GPU采购约为2025年营收三倍，交易对手、资金和变现披露仍不足。

确认条件：资金来源、下游客户、收入合同与交付安排清晰并持续获得正向价格确认后才重评。

风险与失效：预付款、交期、上游调价和资产减值风险显著；单日反弹不构成多头证据。

板块轮动看板

受益方向磷化铟/光器件上游、餐饮消费；仅限公司催化与价格同时确认
观察方向创业板分化企稳；AMD映射保留但不外推为恒科普涨
压力方向恒生科技、电网设备未确认标的及游族超大额采购风险
验证信号恒科收复前收、威胜站回25.86元；否则继续事件驱动

逻辑链

上证小跌、创业板小涨 → A股由急跌转为分化企稳 → 允许结构机会但不等于全面风险偏好修复。
磷化铟长单 + 云南锗业涨停 → 公司催化获价格确认 → 升为多头候选并保留许可/订单风险。
百胜利润增长 + 港股涨2.80% → 业绩获本地确认 → 升为多头候选但关注同店销售。
威胜中标 + 股价跌0.81% → 催化未获确认 → 降为回避；游族反弹不足以覆盖资金风险。
恒科跌1.21%、加密无直接A/H敞口 → 只作选择性映射 → 禁止板块化追涨。

风险雷达

港股科技背离恒生科技09:59跌1.21%，明显弱于隔夜科技信号。
公告执行云南锗业依赖出口许可和订单，威胜部分项目未签正式合同。
大额采购游族GPU合同显著高于现有营收，资金与变现仍不清晰。
消费持续性百胜中国同店销售仍低于上年，正反馈需后续营运数据延续。
数据时效09:59为公开延迟行情；AKShare仍是11月2日历史快照。

数据来源与时间点

首轮研究截止2026-11-04 08:35 CST；09:15增量复核的公开延迟行情抓取于09:59 CST。增量证据：上证-0.21%、创业板+0.32%、恒指-0.31%、恒科-1.21%，云南锗业+10.00%、威胜信息-0.81%、百胜中国+2.80%、游族网络+1.68%。未发现08:35后足以压过上述开盘反馈的已核验重大政策或交易所公告。首轮法定来源、Reuters/AMD及GitHub Actions/Moomoo快照继续有效；AKShare fetchedAt 2026-11-02 14:05 CST仅作历史基线。

Major News Digest
Global
Middle East deal remains distant as oil eases
Reuters said the US and Iran remained far from an agreement, while US forces struck air-defense targets on Iran's Qeshm Island. Brent settled 1.12% lower at $103.60. Lower oil helps airlines, logistics and downstream manufacturers, but escalation can reverse the move quickly. Source: Reuters.
Policy
CNY100 billion swap facility supports equities
The PBOC conducted a CNY100 billion securities-fund-insurance swap operation on Nov 3; buyback relending became a standing arrangement with the rate cut to 1%. The tools improve liquidity for institutions and issuers but do not guarantee a broad rally in expensive themes. Source: PBOC notice transcript.
Policy
FX reserve requirement rises to 6%
The PBOC will raise banks' FX reserve ratio from 4% to 6% on Nov 15 to manage FX liquidity and discourage one-way yuan appreciation; Reuters estimates about $24 billion of FX liquidity will be absorbed. Exporters may see less translation pressure, while foreign-flow sensitivity bears watching. Sources: PBOC report and Reuters.
Policy
NDRC advances new pillars and AI Plus
The NDRC's Nov 3 briefing covered emerging pillar industries, future industries, AI Plus, data factors and Digital China. This supports compute, data infrastructure and industrial digitization over the medium term, but near-term trades still require orders and price confirmation. Source: NDRC.
US Tech
AMD beats as semiconductors rebound
AMD posted Q3 revenue of $13.4 billion and adjusted EPS of $2.09; data-center revenue rose 97% year over year. Its Q4 revenue outlook is about $17 billion, above consensus. The runtime extended-hours quote was $483.90, up 3.73% versus the prior close, mapping to A/H servers, advanced packaging, PCB and optical communications. Sources: AMD and runtime public quotes.
Ranking
Electrical equipment and crypto lead; food distribution lags
In the Nov 3 US cash session, electrical equipment rose 5.76%, electronic components 4.02%, crypto mining 13.77% and crypto treasury 5.83%, while food distribution fell 6.34%. Power equipment, storage and optical components map to A/H; no direct A/H crypto exposure was verified, so no sentiment-only pick is manufactured. Source: GitHub Actions/Moomoo snapshot at 08:32 CST.
Confirmed
Yunnan Germanium hits limit-up on the InP deal
At 09:59 the stock was CNY75.38, up 10.00%, with a CNY75.38 high and CNY72.00 low versus the CNY68.53 prior close. Annual orders, export permits, capacity and yields remain risks. Sources: Eastmoney delayed quotes and the filing transcript.
Risk
Yoozoo rebound does not offset purchase risk
At 09:59 Yoozoo was CNY10.90, up 1.68%, but the CNY4.225 billion GPU purchase is about three times 2025 revenue and lacks sufficient counterparty, funding, customer and monetization detail. It remains an avoid. Sources: Eastmoney delayed quotes and CNINFO.
Not confirmed
Willfar lacks opening price confirmation
At 09:59 Willfar was CNY25.65, down 0.81% and below the CNY25.86 prior close, so the CNY231 million award catalyst lacked positive feedback and the stock is downgraded to avoid. Sources: Eastmoney delayed quotes and the SSE page.
Returns
Dongshan controlling holders propose stronger returns
The controlling shareholders proposed a three-year return arrangement, with at least CNY1 billion of 2026 dividends plus buybacks. It is not a board resolution and still needs board and shareholder approvals. The stock closed Nov 3 at CNY88.13, down 4.41%. Source: CNINFO filing.
Confirmed
Yum China gains 2.80% after earnings
At 09:59 Yum China was HKD389.40, up 2.80% versus HKD378.80, confirming Q3 revenue, operating-profit and EPS gains of 8%, 13% and 20%. Same-store sales were still only 97% of the prior-year level. Sources: Eastmoney delayed quotes and the HKEX filing.
Market
A-shares stabilize unevenly while HSTECH weakens
At 09:59 Shanghai was down 0.21%, ChiNext up 0.32%, Hang Seng down 0.31% and HSTECH down 1.21%. A-shares stabilized unevenly after the selloff, but Hong Kong tech did not follow the US rebound, narrowing the mapping to price-confirmed company catalysts. Source: Eastmoney delayed quotes.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Indexes
Extended-hours ETF proxies keep tech firm and the Dow weak
Runtime public quotes at 08:17-08:18 CST: QQQ $685.28, +0.63% versus the prior close; SPY $754.35, +0.30%; DIA $517.06, -0.44%. These are extended-hours ETF proxies showing cumulative changes versus the prior close; the source does not isolate a separate post-close leg.
Sector Check
Strong groups are confirmed while weak-group leaders diverge
Industry Top5 leaders STI +20.10%, ARRY +22.37%, YDKG +15.73%, SCNX +4.64% and FN +15.58% confirm positive direction. Bottom5 leaders PLBL +2.72%, SOC +0.61%, EPSM +8.31%, BXBL +3.88% and MTEX +2.52% move opposite their negative industries, a potential reversal/stock-level divergence. Concept leaders RIOT +18.50%, BTBT +15.39%, CLSK +14.06% and ARTL +7.37% confirm positive direction; MTWO is unavailable. Quote times span 06:35-08:19 CST.
A/H Mapping
Overnight strength receives only selective confirmation
Yunnan Germanium's limit-up confirms upstream optics and Yum China's 2.80% rise confirms earnings; Willfar's 0.81% decline and HSTECH's 1.21% loss reject broad grid and tech rallies. Crypto still has no verified direct A/H operating exposure, so no sentiment-only pick is created.

Intraday Conclusion

By 09:59 A-shares had stabilized unevenly, while Yunnan Germanium's limit-up and Yum China's 2.80% gain confirmed the InP contract and consumer earnings.

HSTECH fell 1.21%, materially lagging the Hang Seng and overnight US tech, while Willfar lost 0.81%; neither a broad tech rally nor a broad grid-catalyst mapping was confirmed.

The strategy narrows to price-confirmed classification: Yunnan Germanium and Yum China are bullish candidates; Willfar and Yoozoo are avoids. Crypto still has no direct verified A/H candidate.

Key Stocks

Yunnan Germanium
002428.SZ
Bullish Candidate

Facts and status: At 09:59 the stock was CNY75.38, up 10.00% at limit-up, confirming the long-term InP agreement; the 2027 contract is about CNY1.305 billion.

Confirmation: After any reopening, hold the main post-filing trading zone with no adverse change to orders or permits.

Risk and invalidation: Delivery depends on orders, permits, capacity and yields. A high-volume break below CNY68.53 or permit blockage invalidates the setup.

Risk and invalidation: Some projects are unsigned, while revenue and margin depend on delivery; it does not qualify as a bullish card now.

Yum China

Bullish Candidate

Risk and invalidation: Same-store sales were only 97% of the prior-year level; a break below the prior close triggers a downgrade.

Confirmation: Reassess only after funding, customers, revenue contracts and delivery become clear and sustained positive confirmation appears.

Risk and invalidation: Prepayments, delivery, repricing and impairment risks remain material; one rebound is not bullish evidence.

Logic Chain

InP contract + Yunnan Germanium limit-up → price-confirmed catalyst → bullish candidate with execution risk.
Yum profit growth + 2.80% Hong Kong gain → local earnings confirmation → bullish candidate with same-store risk.
Willfar award + 0.81% decline → catalyst not confirmed → avoid; Yoozoo rebound does not offset funding risk.
HSTECH down 1.21% and no direct A/H crypto exposure → selective mapping only → no sector chasing.
